domainsDefault.note: Default domain grouping for the Data model map. A table belongs to the domain whose `tables` list names it exactly (an exact name always beats a prefix), else the first domain whose `prefixes` match its start; everything else is 'Other'. Editable in World Shell > Data model map > Settings (saved as config_state row data_model_map_rules); the shipped file is only the default.
